content.short: Based on the first cross-chain bridge CBTC, MicroChains is committed to providing a safer and better cross-chain.
content.description: MicroChains (previously was CBTC Bridge) carries the mission of “ The Power to Bridge More Emerging Chains”. It is committed to providing more secure cross-chain solutions to emerging chains and all public chains. MicroChains invents the VoMEN Network security solution to greatly improve cross-chain services. VoMEN Network is the combination of multiple internal verifications and enhanced nodes network validation. Also, top Trust company HuobiTrust is invited to be the third-party supervisor to jointly prevent assets theft, over-issuance, and abuse.
content.meta: Find out about MicroChains (MICROCHAINS) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
